# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#
# AAC-LC, written here. No submodule, no runtime library, no OS codec -- the
# second decoder in this tree with no dependency of any kind, after decode_alac.
#
# aac_tables.cpp is generated by tools/gen_aac_tables.py and committed, so no
# build needs the network or Python.
#
# The codec is a library as well as a module, so the tests and the fuzzer can
# drive it without loading anything.

add_library(mediaperch_aac STATIC aac.cpp aac_tables.cpp)
target_include_directories(mediaperch_aac PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(mediaperch_aac PUBLIC mediaperch_mp4 PRIVATE mediaperch_flags)
set_target_properties(mediaperch_aac PROPERTIES FOLDER "modules")

add_library(mp_decode_aac MODULE decode_aac.cpp)

target_link_libraries(mp_decode_aac PRIVATE MediaPerch::abi mediaperch_flags mediaperch_aac)

set_target_properties(mp_decode_aac PROPERTIES
    PREFIX ""
    OUTPUT_NAME "mp_decode_aac"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    FOLDER "modules")

foreach(config IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER "${config}" upper)
    set_target_properties(mp_decode_aac PROPERTIES
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${upper} "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${config}"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${upper} "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/${config}")
endforeach()
